notes.g-tense-02: Cue 'at the moment' replaced by sentence-initial 'Currently'; simple present 'investigate' is now the near-miss (currently + simple present works for states, not a one-off repair). Level 1->2.
notes.g-voice-02: Non-existent 'have been risen' replaced by real form 'are rising' (right verb, wrong tense for 'since').
notes.g-connect-03: Semicolon split into two sentences; options capitalized; 'Therefore' is the near-miss (grammatical, wrong direction).
notes.g-pos-06: consider- family replaced by dramatic/drama/dramatically/dramatize; stem lengthened; 'made it dramatic' is the near-miss.
notes.g-toing-01: Leeds -> invented 'Harwyn Street branch' (stem and zh); stays reviewed.
notes.g-pos-07: Adverb in end position: find X easily vs find X easy (object complement); 'without calling ... for directions' shows find = locate. Band medium.
notes.g-pos-08: Main-verb slot: 'The results ... indicating that ...' reads fine locally, but the sentence then has no finite verb. Band medium.
notes.g-tense-06: Future perfect; relative clause 'who joined' + 'for thirty-two years' lure 'has been', only 'when she retires at the end of next month' at the end decides. Band hard.
notes.g-connect-06: provided that vs unless in a two-clause stem; the opening Because-clause (dock unstaffed) rules out 'unless'. Band hard.
notes.g-participle-05: Reduced passive relative: 'were hired' fits the first half, ruled out by the later main verb 'have recommended'. Band medium.
notes.g-prep-05: Formal phrase in accordance with (the guidelines); near-miss 'in response to'. Band easy.
notes.g-prep-06: Verb + preposition attribute A to B with a long A; near-miss 'from' (shipments from delays) fits locally. Band medium.
notes.g-prep-07: Correspondence phrase on behalf of; near-miss 'in favor of', ruled out by 'our annual awards dinner'. Band easy.
notes.g-relative-04: Classic who vs whom with inserted 'it believes' (candidates who it believes are...). Reviewer please judge: some usage guides tolerate 'whom' here; standard answer is who. Band hard.
notes.g-agree-04: Each of the + plural with a long insertion ('including the three that opened...'); lure 'are'. Band medium.
notes.g-quantity-04: fewer vs less with the head noun 'errors' separated by 'shipping and billing'; less is informal with count nouns. Band medium.
notes.g-mandative-03: recommend that + base form with singular subject; -s form 'checks' is the lure; no 'should' option. Reviewer please judge BrE covert-mandative tolerance. Band hard.
notes.g-compare-04: twice as ... as; near-miss 'more' (twice more powerful) ruled out by the later 'as'. Band easy.
notes.g-toing-04: Verb + preposition contribute to + V-ing; adverb 'significantly' separates verb and blank so 'to reduce' looks like a purpose infinitive. Band medium.
notes.g-pronoun-04: Those who + plural verb; 'Anyone who registered ...' fits until the distant 'are'. Band medium.
notes.g-conditional-03: Formal-letter inversion 'Should you have any questions'; near-miss 'Would' (reads as a question until 'please contact'). Band easy.
